title: We're looking for a Summer 2027 Research Intern at NVIDIA Research
summary: Human Performance and Experience (HPX) team at NVIDIA Research is looking for research interns who are passionate about one or more of the following topics: Human-inspired artificial intelligence, gamining AI, and AI content authenticity. We expect candidates with backgrounds in computer vision, human vision science, robotic vision, and related fields. Please reach out to me with your CV.

title: Spatial-IQ featured by NVIDIA AI Channel
summary: NVIDIA AI Channel highlighted Spatial-IQ on X, LinkedIn, and Facebook, introducing its nine sub-tasks for evaluating perception and reasoning in 3D object counting. The posts also featured our training results: Qwen2.5-VL-32B improved from 2.9% to 62.6% object-counting accuracy.
